title: eng-platform
text:
eng-platform

marco: quick idea drop 3 cost-first lanes for telemetry reprocess: preemptible, shared, reserved. opt-in per-tenant. console shows cost/risk.

marco: intent is to save $$ on large backfills while preserving SLA paths for high-urgency slices.

tara: concrete lanes make sense. how do we surface risks to users?

marco: console preview: estimated_cost_cents + risk_score + historical preempt rate for tenant/region. tooltip explains tradeoffs.

lin: quotas: must be separate counters. propose replay.quota.preemptible/shared/reserved with soft limits and burn-rate UI.

devon: API changes? minimal opt-in fields on POST /v1/replays: lane_hint, max_retries, escalation_policy. default keeps current behavior.

marco: sample request in body for RFC, keep fields optional. response includes estimated_cost_cents and risk_score.

ops-bot: alert: us-east preemption rate now 18% (5m avg).

peggy: telemetry/billing: emit attempt-level events: replay.lane, attempt_idx, preempted, attempt_cost_cents, settlement_id. final settlement event for billing.

lin: scheduler note: preserve shard-local placement preference; allow cross-shard if wait > 2m for preemptible. add locality_score.

marco: rollout: feature-flag + tenant opt-in 10%->30%->100%, region kill-switch. simulate 14-day historic run and publish expected savings/escalation rates before alpha.

devon: i'll take API schema review. marco please open RFC + PR with small sim artifact.

marco: will do tomorrow. thanks folks.
